evidence.evidence_text: Empirical benchmarking of state-of-the-art MLLMs on WildScore reveals intriguing patterns in their visual-symbolic reasoning, uncovering both promising directions and persistent challenges for MLLMs in symbolic music reasoning and analysis.We release the dataset and code.
Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across various vision-language tasks.
To facilitate a comprehensive evaluation, we propose a systematic taxonomy,comprising both high-level and fine-grained musicological ontologies.
